description: Compute is polymorphic on `computeType`; the converted model keeps only the base members, so S.Struct strips the per-type `properties` payload (AmlCompute vmSize/scaleSettings, ComputeInstance vmSize, ...) on encode and decode. Add `properties` as a free-form document on the request and response shapes.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Per-computeType properties (e.g. AmlCompute: vmSize, vmPriority, scaleSettings).
Per-computeType properties (e.g. AmlCompute: vmSize, vmPriority, scaleSettings, currentNodeCount).
